title: B-SDD Sovereign Remote Architecture & Documentation Integration

author: Gemini Spark Architect
steps: Verify MCP Gateway SSE and JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoints
Expose sovereign documentation tools (bsdd_docs_list, bsdd_docs_read, bsdd_docs_write)
